private _transfer: validates addresses, sets fees, performs cooldown/timestamp checks, triggers swapTokensForEth + sendETHToFee (external calls before state settlement) then _tokenTransfer
private lockTheSwap swapTokensForEth: approves router and performs swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with block.timestamp deadline
private sendETHToFee: pushes ETH to both fee wallets using transfer
onlyOwner openTrading: deploys router/pair, approves, addLiquidityETH, enables swap/cooldown, sets maxTx and trading flag
external manualswap: access-gated by _msgSender()==_feeAddrWallet1 and calls swapTokensForEth
external manualsend: access-gated by _msgSender()==_feeAddrWallet1 and calls sendETHToFee
private _tokenTransfer delegating to _transferStandard
private _transferStandard: computes values, mutates _rOwned balances, calls _takeTeam and _reflectFee
private _takeTeam: mints reflection share to the contract address
private _reflectFee: decreases _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal using SafeMath
private tokenFromReflection: validates against _rTotal and divides by current rate
private _getValues: orchestrates _getTValues/_getRValues/_getRate to derive amount components
private _getTValues: computes tFee, tTeam and tTransferAmount using SafeMath mul/div/sub
private _getRValues: computes rAmount, rFee and rTransferAmount using SafeMath
private _getRate: divides reflection supply by token supply
private _getCurrentSupply: returns _rTotal/_tTotal supply pair, with division used for bounds comparison
onlyOwner setBots: writes bots[] blacklist entries from a caller-supplied array
onlyOwner delBot: clears a bots[] entry
onlyOwner setCooldownEnabled: toggles cooldownEnabled
private _approve: validates addresses and writes _allowances
public transfer: forwards _msgSender()/recipient/amount to _transfer
public transferFrom: performs _transfer then allowance decrement via SafeMath sub
public approve: calls _approve with _msgSender() as owner
public balanceOf: returns tokenFromReflection(_rOwned[account])
onlyOwner renounceOwnership: sets _owner to address(0)
public view owner: returns _owner
msg.sender via _msgSender(): attacker-controllable caller used for auth, transfers, approvals and privileged gates
block.timestamp: miner-influenced value used for cooldown window and swap/liquidity deadlines
external call uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with amountOutMin=0 and timestamp deadline
external ETH transfer via _feeAddrWallet1.transfer/_feeAddrWallet2.transfer
external payable call uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH using full contract ETH balance
external call IERC20(uniswapV2Pair).approve(router, type(uint).max) granting unlimited allowance
SafeMath add/sub/mul/div arithmetic operations on reflection and token amounts
